1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Three distinct carriers with two requested shapes, broad illumination and responsive scanner; deliberate actions advance fixed steps and waiting is inert.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Four carriers with two requested shapes, a smaller lens, longer pulse flight and faster changing current; all evolution is action-triggered.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Five carriers include a near-matching decoy; two targets share one scanner and collide, with fixed progress per deliberate action.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Two near-matching decoys, faster current evolution, smaller scanner and stronger inertial lag; idle time cannot move the scene.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Eight interacting carriers, three near-matches and three requested shapes; narrow illumination and long fixed pulse transitions couple search, identity tracking and interception.

full.summary: Grab the visible scanner crosshair and drag it; SPACE emits a delayed pulse.
full.natural_language: Start the survey and fully illuminate every shell to optically certify all numbered plates. Then tag only the requested silhouettes. Grab and drag the crosshair; SPACE emits a pulse. The numbered contact sheet retains exposed pixels and shows full glyphs after optical certification. Pulses arm only when every plate is certified. White arrows show velocity; blue arrows show the changing current. Each deliberate scanner action advances one fixed 120 ms simulation step; waiting leaves positions, flow, recharge and action opportunities unchanged. Firing completes its displayed fixed pulse flight as an action-triggered transition. A miss, protected tag, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.

simplified.summary: Click a target point in the tank to steer the same scanner; PULSE is the proxy for SPACE.
